meta.subtitle: Lunar New Year · Interactive Workbook

dialogue: 大文
老师说华人新年快到了。
The teacher said Lunar New Year is almost here.
lǎo shī shuō huá rén xīn nián kuài dào le.

data:image/webp;base64,
爸爸
对，下个星期五是华人新年。
Yes, next Friday is Lunar New Year.
duì, xià ge xīng qī wǔ shì huá rén xīn nián.

data:image/webp;base64,
大文
妈妈会去超市买年糕吗？
Will Mom go to the supermarket to buy New Year rice cake?
mā ma huì qù chāo shì mǎi nián gāo ma?

data:image/webp;base64,
爸爸
会，那天我们还要给爷爷奶奶拜年。
Yes, that day we also need to offer New Year greetings to Grandpa and Grandma.
huì, nà tiān wǒ men hái yào gěi yé ye nǎi nai bài nián.

data:image/webp;base64,
大文
太好了，爷爷每年都会给我红包。
Great! Grandpa gives me a red envelope every year.
tài hǎo le, yé ye měi nián dōu huì gěi wǒ hóng bāo.

data:image/webp;base64,
爸爸
如果在台湾，我们还会贴春联、放鞭炮。
If we were in Taiwan, we would also put up spring couplets and set off firecrackers.
rú guǒ zài tái wān, wǒ men hái huì tiē chūn lián, fàng biān pào.

reading.title: Reading Comprehension · 阅读理解
reading.instruction: Read May’s original workbook diary and answer the questions.
passage: 今天是二月七号星期一，老师说下个星期二是农历新年。
jīn tiān shì èr yuè qī hào xīng qī yī, lǎo shī shuō xià ge xīng qī èr shì nóng lì xīn nián.
Today is Monday, February 7. The teacher says next Tuesday is Lunar New Year.
那天妈妈会去华人超市买年糕。
nà tiān mā ma huì qù huá rén chāo shì mǎi nián gāo.
That day Mom will buy rice cakes at the Chinese supermarket.
我们会贴春联、放鞭炮，还会给爷爷奶奶拜年。
wǒ men huì tiē chūn lián, fàng biān pào, hái huì gěi yé ye nǎi nai bài nián.
We will put up spring couplets, set off firecrackers, and offer New Year greetings to our grandparents.
爷爷每年都会给我红包。
yé ye měi nián dōu huì gěi wǒ hóng bāo.
Grandpa gives me a red envelope every year.
wǒ zuì xǐ huan nóng lì xīn nián le.
Lunar New Year is my favorite.

prompt: 农历新年是几月几号星期几？
nóng lì xīn nián shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào xīng qī jǐ?
What date and weekday is Lunar New Year?
options: shì èr yuè bā hào xīng qī èr.
shì èr yuè shí sān hào xīng qī tiān.
shì èr yuè shí sì hào xīng qī yī.
shì èr yuè shí wǔ hào xīng qī èr.

prompt: nóng lì xīn nián huì zuò shén me?
What will they do for Lunar New Year? Select all three correct answers.
options: gěi yé ye nǎi nai bài nián.
